scientific_question: Can one deterministic geometry-conditioned 1280-mode response-subspace coreset preserve the complete K1 capacity recovered by v189 while retaining high-frequency detector-potential information and supporting both five and nine active cameras?
role: post-open compact-representation capacity diagnostic on exactly the same four already-open p=22kw_size=01 frames; it is not predictor training, a complete-trajectory gate, a resource benchmark, fresh generalization, or real BOST
physical_hypothesis: The v189 full non-DC DCT response has rank 1009 in both sensor arms. A geometry/setup-local QDEIM column coreset built only from that response row space can retain all identifiable affine directions while selecting physically informative low and high detector frequencies. A fixed 1280-feature budget provides 271 deterministic leverage-ranked redundancy columns beyond the 1009 QDEIM anchors and should preserve the unchanged physical CGLS K1 gate if DCT12 failed because it discarded the wrong frequencies rather than because all 575 modes per camera are intrinsically required.
physical_distinction: v190 keeps the v189 potential integration, full 24x24 per-camera DCT, canonical camera order, affine field basis, four p22 frames, reported geometries, five/all-nine sensor arms, K0/K1 refinement, metrics, gates and exact-call ledger unchanged. Its only scientific change is a response-subspace column coreset selected before heldout observations are constructed. It does not pool cameras, append descriptors, fit a predictor, read truth, search a budget, add ridge, damping, clipping, fallback or candidate selection.

data_isolation.fit_source: reuse only the sealed v186.1 affine center and 1009-row basis; rebuild each v189 full-DCT response from frozen reported geometry and forward operators before selecting columns
data_isolation.heldout_source: the same already-open p=22kw_size=01 frame indices 0,25,75,100 used by v185-v189
data_isolation.selection_must_finish_before: constructing heldout observations, heldout detector potentials, heldout features, candidate coordinates or fields
heldout_truth_forbidden_from: full response construction, row-space SVD, QDEIM pivots, leverage scores, selected indices, selected feature order and inverse threshold
coordinates, K0 field, K1 step size, fallback, stopping, any descriptor, regularizer, candidate, budget or decision choice
heldout_truth_allowed_only_for: synthetic observations through the frozen forward operator
final field and gradient scoring after observation-only K0 candidates are sealed

primary.name: geometry_qdeim1280_camera_resolved_full_dct_coreset
primary.full_feature_parent: v189 orthonormal type-II 24x24 DCT per active camera with only DC removed and cameras concatenated in canonical numeric ID order
selection_rule: compute the thin SVD H=U diag(s) V^T of the full setup response H with scipy.linalg.svd, LAPACK gesdd and threshold s0*sqrt(float64 epsilon)
require retained rank exactly 1009 and apply scipy.linalg.qr with pivoting to the retained V^T row-space matrix; the first 1009 pivot columns are the QDEIM anchors
compute invariant row-space leverage l_j=sum_i V_ij^2; among non-anchor columns append the first 271 indices under the total order (-l_j, global canonical feature index)
sort the resulting 1280 unique global indices increasingly before gathering response and observation features
primary.tie_break: smallest global canonical feature index after exact descending float64 leverage ordering; QDEIM pivot order is the scipy.linalg.qr pivot order and must independently reproduce exactly
primary.selected_inverse: apply the unchanged fixed-threshold Moore-Penrose inverse to the 1009x1280 selected response using scipy.linalg.svd with LAPACK gesdd
primary.candidate_field: x0=affine_center+a affine_basis, followed by either K0 or one unchanged identity-preconditioned physical CGLS step

blocking_references.v189_full_non_dc_dct: sealed positive full-basis capacity reference; no rerun or retuning

evaluation.physical_k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned physical CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual and denominator floor 1e-30
evaluation.subset_rule: reuse the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge five-camera subset frozen before p22 truth was opened

cost_ledger.offline_geometry_cost: 26 full v189 response builds, full-response row-space SVDs, QDEIM QR factorizations and selected-response SVDs; these are diagnostic setup costs and not deployment speed evidence
cost_ledger.online_feature_cost: one full per-camera 24x24 DCT followed by gathering 1280 cached indices; no extra exact A or A^T
cost_ledger.response_storage: only 1009x1280 selected response matrices and factors are eligible for later caching; the full matrices are streamed and not retained
cost_ledger.resource_claim: none before a separately frozen complete-trajectory gate, fair controls, fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS

required_validity_gates: the complete v189 formal, independent and decision trees remain unchanged
selection for all 26 setups finishes before any heldout observation or truth-derived array is built
full response shapes are 1009x2875 and 1009x5175; selected response shape is exactly 1009x1280
each selection contains exactly 1280 unique sorted in-range indices, 1009 QDEIM anchors and 271 leverage supplements
the full response retained rank and selected response retained rank are both exactly 1009
every active camera contributes at least one selected mode and at least one selected mode outside the v188 12x12 block
selected indices, leverage values, coordinates and fields are deterministic under repeated execution
reversing input camera iteration order leaves full features, selected indices, selected features, coordinates and K0 fields unchanged within 1e-10
fixed-observation truth mutation leaves selected indices, coordinates and K0 candidates byte-identical
prediction APIs accept no truth, trajectory, time, power or size input
K0/K1 candidates, metrics and exact-call arrays are finite and match the frozen shapes
physical K1 has no denominator breakdown
formal and parent input trees remain unchanged
the independent second implementation rebuilds full features, row-space selection, selected inverse, physical replay, gates and receipts without importing formal v190 helpers

must_independently_rebuild: all 26 full DCT responses and 26 QDEIM-plus-leverage selections using LAPACK gesvd for SVD and an independent explicit canonical camera loop
all selected 1009x1280 responses, gesvd pseudoinverses, ranks, conditions, coordinates and K0 fields
p22 observations, unchanged physical K1 fields, metrics, tails, decisions and exact-call receipts

decision_order: Any parent, identity, isolation, shape, selection, rank, high-frequency, camera-order, inverse, mutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal or independent-recomputation failure makes v190 inconclusive.

If QDEIM1280 K1 passes 52/52 cells and 13/13 calibrations in both sensor arms, conclude PASS_GEOMETRY_QDEIM1280_CORESET_CAPACITY_V190: a compact geometry-conditioned high-frequency coreset has post-open capacity headroom under the frozen four-frame gate.

If QDEIM1280 K1 fails either sensor arm despite all validity and independent gates passing, conclude FAIL_GEOMETRY_QDEIM1280_CORESET_CAPACITY_V190 and close this fixed 1280-column response-subspace family without changing the budget or using a larger model to rescue it.

A passing result authorizes only a separately frozen complete-trajectory accuracy gate with Zero/BP/CGLS/PCGLS/dual-ridge controls. It does not establish a deployable learned initializer, exact-call reduction, wall/RSS speedup, external generalization or real BOST.
No v190 outcome supports first, SOTA, global uniqueness, paper success or algorithm breakthrough.
